articles.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
articles.snippet: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

articles.title: Strategy Buys $30M in Bitcoin, Moves $1B From USD Reserve to Cash Pot
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor's firm raised its preferred stock buyback program to $4 billion after repurchasing another $212 million of STRC last week.
